purpose: Provide a concrete provisional choice for each of the 134 functional and timing fields in the current GEMM-path specification.
evidence_boundary: Complete profile coverage does not mean complete hardware identification. Engineering assumptions permit simulation and sensitivity tests; they are not measured facts. The proof registry remains authoritative and unchanged. The integrated full-GEMM simulator is not yet validated.
timing_contract: Respect the unit and scope of each entry. Compound measured instruction recurrence costs include dependencies or scheduling; do not add a second copy of the same delays. Reference-clock conversions do not establish clock topology.

discovery_rounds/provisional_execution_p: Use mutually exclusive EFFECTIVE_DEPENDENCY or DECOMPOSED timing for each supported opcode.
EFFECTIVE_DEPENDENCY uses T014/T016 without adding ordinary register, collector, wakeup or fixed writeback costs; retain native control timing and independently justified contention.
DECOMPOSED sums read, collection, execution and selected bypass OR register-write path, plus wakeup; T014/T016 become comparison targets. Do not charge both bypass and writeback.
MOVM native-barrier replay uses effective recurrence29cycles and decoded controls, with no4.8cycle throughput throttle.
T007 tensor interval4 and T018 are aliases; enforce once.
discovery_rounds/provisional_memory_prof: Do not add compound measured path latency to separately modeled dependencies: calibrate one decomposition at a time.
L2 sets*ways*128*slices must remain96MiB. Baseline48x1024x16; alternative64x768x16. These geometries are assumptions.
Shared+usableL1+modeled overhead must not exceed128KiB; profile baseline32+64+32KiB.
Timing ranges are sensitivity domains, not measured confidence intervals. Controller timings expressed in SM-reference cycles do not identify controller clock frequency.
T042 is aggregate transfer pacing; per-controller32-byte interval is16times this baseline for balanced traffic.
Keep official proof counts unchanged. F053 retains its identified functional contract; other fallback portions remain unsupported.
L1 capacity = L1 sets * associativity *128 bytes. Shared storage + L1 storage + overhead must fit128KiB. Overhead32KiB is a baseline for shared32KiB/L164KiB only; it must change for other partitions.
L2 baseline capacity =48*1024*16*128=96MiB; nominal64-slice alternative requires768sets/slice to preserve96MiB.
Keep modeled aggregate L2 return bandwidth768 bytes/reference cycle as an independent bottleneck when varying slice count; do not silently infer physical port counts from it.
Controller mapping must give2048bytes/bank row and remain bijective; update mapping jointly when geometry changes.
